# Zixflow

AI-CRM and Messaging Across SMS, Email, and WhatsApp

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/zixflow/.

## Actions

- **Get Email Report** (read-only): Retrieve email message delivery report from Zixflow.
- **Get SMS Report** (read-only): Retrieve SMS message delivery report from Zixflow.
- **Get WhatsApp Campaign Report** (read-only): Retrieve WhatsApp campaign message report.
- **Create Attribute**: Create a custom attribute for a Zixflow collection or list.
- **Get WhatsApp Template Variables** (read-only): Retrieve template variable details for a WhatsApp template.
- **List Attribute Options** (read-only): Retrieve the list of options for select/multiselect attributes.
- **List Attribute Status Options** (read-only): Retrieve the list of options for status attributes in Zixflow.
